title: The runtime has no deterministic scheduler/effect/environment capture
expected_semantics: A deterministic replay should reproduce the same relevant execution under recorded scheduler choices, inputs, effects, environment, and external boundaries.
actual_behavior_limitation: The runtime exposes a bounded request/result but no scheduler decision log, effect result log, filesystem/environment snapshot, or process identity contract. The debugger only offers bounded re-execution and says so.
why_capability_matters: Failure analysis cannot distinguish a stable program failure from a schedule/effect/environment race without replay control and evidence.
current_workaround: Embed program/request bytes and compare bounded status, failure identity, test id, and return digest; deterministic requests are described as reproduction, never deterministic replay.

host_language_code_required.classification: temporary adapter caused by an identified MNCS pressure
host_language_code_required.why: The host can resubmit immutable inputs and compare result documents but cannot reconstruct missing execution decisions.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Add an opt-in replay log contract for scheduler decisions, effect inputs/results, relevant environment/filesystem facts, process ancestry, and replay compatibility identity.
resolution_criteria: A nondeterministic fixture has a replay recipe that records all relevant choices/effects and a runtime replay mode that proves compatibility rather than merely matching a result digest.
